title: shot-02 / unit-02 H3 视频(FL2VA·脆响抬眼→切)
prompt:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 2) aligns with the 6.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, cool teal-white private dining room at night, same enclosed room and camera as Shot 01 (wood lattice screen, soft wall sconce, warm wood partition, blurred). The opening matches Picture 1: Lin Wan — long black hair, plain cool-toned knit top, restrained expression — sits with her chopsticks resting at the edge of her now-empty small dish, gaze lowered; the out-of-focus male colleague isolates her at the near foreground; the shared white communal plate holding several whole shrimp stays at the center-foreground of the table. The camera holds nearly static, then pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. An off-screen crisp shrimp-shell crack cuts through the chatter — nothing cracking is shown in frame; this crack is the sound bridge that will stitch into the next scene — and Lin Wan slowly lifts her gaze from the dish, chin rising, looking past the noise into the distance, a flicker of distraction surfacing. The ending matches Picture 2: her gaze is lifted and fixed on the distance, chin slightly up, chopsticks still paused at the empty dish edge, as the memory is about to open.

overall_soundscape: Layered restaurant chatter and clinking bowls fill the private room; a single crisp shrimp-shell crack cuts through clearly from off-screen, followed by a brief hush settling around her.

non_diegetic_music: A single sustained low string tone, held quietly, swelling slightly toward the end as the memory is about to open.
note: 签名A 声画 match-cut 的出点(A-out)：脆响为画外声音桥、抬眼为可见引信；对白无、以环境声+脆响+冷弦为主，随 H3 视频一起产出(audioPolicy=in_video_first)。首=unit-02-first.png(承接shot01尾帧)，尾=unit-02-last.png(抬眼终态，由首帧锁机位)。
